name: Trade Identification
definition: Specifies the different identifications associated with a trade.

CounterpartyReference.name: Counterparty Reference
CounterpartyReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the trade allocated by the counterparty.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Reference assigned to the trade by the investor or the trading party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to access/update the trade details.

CommonIdentification.name: Common Identification
CommonIdentification.definition: Unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.

MatchingReference.name: Matching Reference
MatchingReference.definition: Reference assigned by a matching system when the trade is matched.

UniqueTradeIdentifier.name: Unique Trade Identifier
UniqueTradeIdentifier.definition: This field specifies the unique transaction identifier (UTI) to be created at the time a transaction is first executed, shared with all registered entities and counterparties involved in the transaction, and used to track that particular transaction over its life. This identifier can also be known as the Unique Swap Identifier (USI).

Trade.name: Trade
Trade.definition: Specifies the trade for which identifications are provided.

ClearingBrokerIdentification.name: Clearing Broker Identification
ClearingBrokerIdentification.definition: Reference number assigned by the clearing broker.

RelatedPostTradeRiskReduction.name: Related Post Trade Risk Reduction
RelatedPostTradeRiskReduction.definition: Post trade risk reduction for which the trade has been created.

RelatedEventIdentifier.name: Related Event Identifier
RelatedEventIdentifier.definition: Derivative event linked to the trade.
